description.zh: 需创建的 Topic 所对应的实例 ID
description.en: The ID of the instance to which the topic to be created belongs.

description.zh: 消息类型。取值说明如下：0：普通消息；1：分区顺序消息；2：全局顺序消息；4：事务消息；5：定时/延时消息。
description.en: The message type. Valid values: 0: normal message. 1: partitionally ordered message. 2: globally ordered message. 4: transactional message. 5: scheduled or delayed message.

description.zh: 需创建的 Topic 的名称
description.en: The name of the topic to be created.

title.zh: 在指定环境实例下创建一个 Topic
title.en: Create a topic in a specified environment instance
